headline: FBR Authorizes Seven Additional Vendors for Beverage Sector Monitoring
summary: Pakistan's Federal Board of Revenue authorized seven additional vendors to supply and maintain electronic production monitoring systems across the beverage sector.
why: Digital excise tracking mandates impose compliance requirements on beverage manufacturers to curb tax evasion and ensure production transparency.

impacts.name: Beverage Sector
impacts.why: Electronic monitoring installation mandates affect operational compliance costs for local manufacturers.
